FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
YATINUWARA PRADESHIYA SABHA
UNDER SECTION 65A (2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS, the office of a member in Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United People's Freedom Alliance, towhich the Former member Gunarathna Adhikaram Mahathmayalage Kolin Udapitiya belonged was required by me underSection 65A(2) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to nominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under theOrdinance for Election as a member of that Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared elected as a member ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. Horathal PeligeWickramasinghe being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy :

NOW THEREFORE I, Mudiyanselage Kumudu Saman Sri Rathnayake, Returning Officer of Yatinuwara PradeshiyaSabha, acting in terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies inLocal Authorities (Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Horathal Pelige Wickramasingheelected as a member of the Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha.
SAMAN SRI RATHNAYAKE,
Returning Officer,Yatinuwara Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Kandy28th November, 2014.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk.

FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE MEMBER OF THE
KALUTARA PRADESHIYA SABHAUNDER SECTION 65A (2) OF THELOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE
(CHAPTER 262) AS AMENDED BYLOCAL AUTHORITIES (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, No. 30 OF 2013
WHEREAS, the office of a member in Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the recognized political party namely United National Party, to which the Formermember Agampodi Weerasiri De Silva belonged was required by me under Section 65A(2) of the aforesaid Ordinance, tonominate within a period of thirty (30) days a person eligible under the Ordinance for Election as a member of that KalutaraPradeshiya Sabha who shall be declared elected as a member ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has nominated Mr. UdugahapaththuwageDon Thusitha Indrathilaka being an eligible person under the aforesaid Ordinance to fill such vacancy :

NOW THEREFORE I, Hannedige Rasika Priyanga Peiris, Returning Officer of Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha, actingin terms of Section 65A(2) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance as amended by filling of vacancies in Local Authorities(Special Provisions) Act, No. 30 of 2013 (Chapter 262) do hereby declare Mr. Udugahapaththuwage Don ThusithaIndrathilaka elected as a member of the Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha.
RASIKA PEIRIS,Returning Officer,Kalutara Pradeshiya Sabha.
District Elections Office,Kalutara,27th November, 2014.
